records.title: HLA: Hadamard Linear Attention
records.reason: Hadamard linear attention is evaluated on video diffusion; transfer to LLM inference remains plausible but unshown.

records.title: The Rescue Effect: Spatio-Semantic Early Exit Bypasses Quantization Collapse in CLIP
records.reason: CLIP early exit/quantization is limited to image retrieval and classification.

records.title: TicketLLM: Next-Generation Sparse and Low-bit Transformers with Supermask-based Method
records.reason: TicketLLM uses sparse low-bit transformer language models to cut model and inference resource cost.

records.title: ARFlow: Autoregressive Flow with Hybrid Linear Attention
records.reason: ARFlow applies hybrid linear attention to image/video flow generation, an independent vision application.

records.title: MI-Pruner: Crossmodal Mutual Information-guided Token Pruner for Efficient MLLMs
records.reason: Mutual-information visual-token pruning reduces MLLM inference work.

records.title: ARL-Tangram: Unleash the Resource Efficiency in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: ARL-Tangram improves agentic reinforcement-learning training-resource scheduling, not inference.

records.title: Graph Signal Processing Meets Mamba2: Adaptive Filter Bank via Delta Modulation
records.reason: HADES adapts Mamba2 and reports comparable language/retrieval quality with 58.9% of baseline parameters.

records.title: MatMamba: A Matryoshka State Space Model
records.reason: MatMamba provides nested state dimensions and compute-adaptive inference for language/vision models.

records.title: EMS-SD: Efficient Multi-sample Speculative Decoding for Accelerating Large Language Models
records.reason: EMS-SD removes variable-acceptance padding overhead in multi-sample LLM speculative decoding.

records.title: SENSE: Semantic Embedding Navigation with Soft-gated Evaluation for Retrieval-based Speculative Decoding
records.reason: SENSE accelerates retrieval-based speculative decoding through semantic embedding navigation and gated evaluation.

records.title: SelKV: Selective KV Cache Merging with Per-Token Merge-or-Drop and Attention Compensation
records.reason: SelKV compresses long-context KV cache through per-token merge/drop and attention compensation.

records.title: RelServe: Fast LLM Inference Serving on Relational Data
records.reason: RelServe scheduling/batching reduces relational LLM-serving latency up to 3.1x.

records.title: Script: Graph-Structured and Query-Conditioned Semantic Token Pruning for Multimodal Large Language Models
records.reason: Script MLLM token pruning reports up to 6.8x prefill and 10x FLOP reduction.

records.title: Activation-aware Probe-Query: Effective Key-Value Retrieval for Long-Context LLMs Inference
records.reason: ActQKV retrieves relevant KV pairs for memory-efficient long-context LLM inference.

records.title: ASTL: An Adaptive Serving Stack for LLMs to Balance Utilization and Tail Latency
records.reason: Official SEAMS abstract describes adaptive LLM runtime parallelism/batching that reduces tail latency while preserving throughput.

records.title: Task Aware One-Shot Pruning for Edge-Deployable Large Language Models
records.reason: IEEE primary page and DOI route inaccessible; only secondary abstract summaries surfaced and were not used.

records.reason: SlimVLM prunes structured weights and visual tokens for efficient VLM inference.

records.title: MoreauPruner: Robust Pruning of Large Language Models against Weight Perturbations
records.reason: MoreauPruner induces robust LLM structured sparsity using a Moreau-envelope weight-importance measure.

records.title: MoEfication: Conditional Computation of Transformer Models for Efficient Inference
records.reason: MoEfication routes transformer-language-model FFN computation conditionally to reduce inference compute.

records.reason: Swordsman adapts diffusion-LM decoding blocks and unmasking thresholds to improve efficiency.
